mapper.select: SELECT hr.ID, hr.FEEDBACK_ID, hr.HANDLER_ID, hr.ACTION, hr.CONTENT, hr.ATTACHMENT_IDS, hr.RESULT, hr.IS_VISIBLE, hr.CREATE_TIME, u.ID AS U_ID, u.USERNAME AS U_USERNAME, u.REAL_NAME AS U_REAL_NAME, u.PHONE AS U_PHONE, u.DEPT_ID AS U_DEPT_ID FROM T_HANDLE_RECORD hr LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON hr.HANDLER_ID = u.ID AND u.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE hr.ID = #{id}

SELECT hr.ID, hr.FEEDBACK_ID, hr.HANDLER_ID, hr.ACTION, hr.CONTENT, hr.ATTACHMENT_IDS, hr.RESULT, hr.IS_VISIBLE, hr.CREATE_TIME, u.ID AS U_ID, u.USERNAME AS U_USERNAME, u.REAL_NAME AS U_REAL_NAME, u.PHONE AS U_PHONE, u.DEPT_ID AS U_DEPT_ID FROM T_HANDLE_RECORD hr LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON hr.HANDLER_ID = u.ID AND u.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE hr.FEEDBACK_ID = #{feedbackId} ORDER BY hr.CREATE_TIME ASC

SELECT hr.ID, hr.FEEDBACK_ID, hr.HANDLER_ID, hr.ACTION, hr.CONTENT, hr.ATTACHMENT_IDS, hr.RESULT, hr.IS_VISIBLE, hr.CREATE_TIME, u.ID AS U_ID, u.USERNAME AS U_USERNAME, u.REAL_NAME AS U_REAL_NAME, u.PHONE AS U_PHONE, u.DEPT_ID AS U_DEPT_ID FROM T_HANDLE_RECORD hr LEFT JOIN SYS_USER u ON hr.HANDLER_ID = u.ID AND u.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE hr.FEEDBACK_ID = #{feedbackId} AND hr.IS_VISIBLE = 1 ORDER BY hr.CREATE_TIME ASC
